title: Start a fresh working branch after every merge, not just the first time
plain: When work is merged it lands on the main line as a brand-new entry, while the original copy stays behind on the working branch. The fix is not the command, it is WHEN you run it: reset the branch as the last step of merging, not as the first step of the next piece of work. Done at merge time there is nothing left to remember. This was learned twice in one afternoon, the second time an hour after writing it down.
